etymologies.etymologyHTML: Borrowed from Latin junior, a contraction of iuvenior (“younger”) which is the comparative of iuvenis (“young”); see juvenile.

definitions.definition: (comparable) Low in rank; having a subordinate role, job, or situation.
(not comparable, often preceded by a possessive adjective or a possessive form of a noun) Younger.
